basics.name: Rosmar Alejandra Mendoza Canchica
basics.label: Software Developer (Backend)
basics.summary: Backend Software Developer with solid experience in designing, building, and optimizing microservices and RESTful APIs using Golang, Python, and Java. Proven track record in high-impact environments such as MercadoLibre and Fintech companies. Specialized in implementing scalable architectures, SQL database integration, and adopting AI-driven development tools (Cursor, Claude) to maximize code quality, refactoring, and software delivery efficiency.

work.name: MercadoLibre
work.summary: Development and optimization of critical microservices in Golang and maintenance of high-scale RESTful APIs.
highlights: Backend Specialization Bootcamp in Golang (Aug 2023 – Dec 2023): Selected to complete MercadoLibre's intensive training program focused on Go, microservices architecture, engineering best practices, and large-scale development standards.

Microservices Development & Maintenance: Designed and developed backend services and RESTful APIs using Golang, Java, and Python, ensuring high availability, maintainability, and code performance (99%+ SLA).
AI-Assisted Engineering Productivity: Integrated AI tools (Cursor, Claude) into daily development workflows to accelerate endpoint construction, refactor legacy code, and boost unit test coverage.
API Operations & Support: Actively participated in system maintenance, monitoring, and on-call shifts to ensure seamless operation of core platform APIs.
